conventions.capital: $10000 fresh per period for new economic comparison; native account continuous start2024 also shown
conventions.cost: 10bp commission+5bp additive slippage per traded notional, both sides; fixed-fill gross adds exact debits, not a frictionless rerun
conventions.sharpe: 252 sessions/year; zero risk-free; sample standard deviation; undefined for zero variance
conventions.sortino: zero minimum acceptable return; root mean squared negative returns over all sessions; undefined for no downside
conventions.turnover: sum absolute executed notional / initial account capital; no halving
conventions.trades: sell fills include partial reductions; both-side fees are in realized P&L; open terminal holdings retained
conventions.spy: frictionless SPY is descriptive only, excluded from matched-capital inference

sensitivity.scope: 54 audit dates; each scenario and strategy starts fresh $10000. Frozen target intent, account quantities/fees/rejections change. Synthetic stress is not a probability forecast.
decisions_changed: risk_gross_60pct proportionally clips weights; model forecasts unchanged
sensitivity.missing_bar: All 4 strategies halted before replay; no fill or forward-filled bar

limitations: No historical untouched holdout remains. These are diagnostics, not new confirmatory evidence.
Price data are current-vintage retrospectively adjusted proxies, with no archived corporate-action event tape, delistings, or historical constituent memberships.
Single-instrument models establish temporal reuse only; held-instrument transfer is a separate registered experiment.
Temperature and legacy gate use the same trailing block; gate slices do not identify independent gate value.
Gross fixed-fill accounting adds debits back to realized net equity; zero-cost replay separately changes quantities and risk rejections.
54 audit account sessions have only 48 mature outcome dates, with strongly overlapping labels. 22 correlated assets are not 22 independent replications.
Fresh-capital audit accounts differ from continuous account period returns due to initial holdings, first rebalance, and fees.
Slippage is an additive fee proxy, not quote-level execution evidence; liquidity and gap stresses are synthetic.
63 prospective sessions and final label maturity must accumulate over time; no backfilled historical rows count.
